1276	    def _prepare_related_fields_for_save(self, operation_name, fields=None):
1277	        # Ensure that a model instance without a PK hasn't been assigned to
1278	        # a ForeignKey, GenericForeignKey or OneToOneField on this model. If
1279	        # the field is nullable, allowing the save would result in silent data
1280	        # loss.
1281	        for field in self._meta.concrete_fields:
1282	            if fields and field not in fields:
1283	                continue
1284	            # If the related field isn't cached, then an instance hasn't been
1285	            # assigned and there's no need to worry about this check.
1286	            if field.is_relation and field.is_cached(self):
1287	                obj = getattr(self, field.name, None)
1288	                if not obj:
1289	                    continue
1290	                # A pk may have been assigned manually to a model instance not
1291	                # saved to the database (or auto-generated in a case like
1292	                # UUIDField), but we allow the save to proceed and rely on the
1293	                # database to raise an IntegrityError if applicable. If
1294	                # constraints aren't supported by the database, there's the
1295	                # unavoidable risk of data corruption.
1296	                if not obj._is_pk_set():
1297	                    # Remove the object from a related instance cache.
1298	                    if not field.remote_field.multiple:
1299	                        field.remote_field.delete_cached_value(obj)
1300	                    raise ValueError(
1301	                        "%s() prohibited to prevent data loss due to unsaved "
1302	                        "related object '%s'." % (operation_name, field.name)
1303	                    )
1304	                if (
1305	                    field_val := getattr(self, field.attname)
1306	                ) in field.empty_values or isinstance(field_val, Expression):
1307	                    # Set related object if it has been saved after an
1308	                    # assignment.
1309	                    setattr(self, field.name, obj)
1310	                # If the relationship's pk/to_field was changed, clear the
1311	                # cached relationship.
1312	                if getattr(obj, field.target_field.attname) != getattr(
1313	                    self, field.attname
1314	                ):
1315	                    field.delete_cached_value(self)
1316	        # GenericForeignKeys are private.
1317	        for field in self._meta.private_fields:
1318	            if fields and field not in fields:
1319	                continue
1320	            if (
1321	                field.is_relation
1322	                and field.is_cached(self)
1323	                and hasattr(field, "fk_field")
1324	            ):
1325	                obj = field.get_cached_value(self, default=None)
1326	                if obj and not obj._is_pk_set():
1327	                    raise ValueError(
1328	                        f"{operation_name}() prohibited to prevent data loss due to "
1329	                        f"unsaved related object '{field.name}'."
1330	                    )
